```typescript
for (let desplazamiento = 0; desplazamiento <= DIAS_POR_SEMANA; desplazamiento++)
```

Fix:





Now let me run the tests to verify:



All 62 tests pass. The bug was an off-by-one in `src/dominio/semana.ts:13`: the loop used `desplazamiento <= DIAS_POR_SEMANA` (0 through 7 = 8 iterations) instead of `desplazamiento < DIAS_POR_SEMANA` (0 through 6 = 7 iterations).
